in_sanskrit.name: शमसद
in_sanskrit.meaning: शम (Shama) - peace, calming, soothing, tranquility सद (Sada) - eternal, constant, everlasting
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Shamsad in Sanskrit is derived from the words शम (Shama) and सद (Sada), which mean peace and eternal, respectively. The name signifies a peaceful being who is eternal and constant.

in_marathi.name: Shamsad
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shamsad हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Shamsad is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Surya', meaning Sun. In Hinduism, Surya is the god of the sun and is revered for his power and life-giving energy. Shamsad is a unisex name that represents light, wisdom, and the divine power of the sun.
